info.title: POS API
info.description: Authenticated point-of-sale operations for branch selection, POS catalog browsing, inventory visibility, POS sale completion, and POS order lookup

variantSku.description: Variant SKU to initialize. Omit to initialize the base product stock.

trackStock.description: Whether this product tracks inventory. When true, sets inventoryType to STOCKED and stock/reservation checks apply; when false (default), the product is always sellable regardless of inventory.
Quick boolean mirror of inventoryType === STOCKED, for fast conditional checks

quantityDelta.description: Signed change applied to total stock

returnStock.description: Optional override; otherwise the merchant return-stock setting is used

webhookSecret.description: Webhook signing secret. Required for the HMAC provider.

providerSecret.description: Primary provider secret, such as a Bakong token or PayWay API key.

config.description: Non-secret provider metadata such as an account identifier

qrImage.description: PayWay data URL for the generated QR image

cashReceived.description: Cash tendered by the customer (CASH only)

orderItemIds.description: Order item ids this payment settles (informational; full/partial split by amount is always enforced)
